items.headline: Signs 4-year, $132M extension ($90M gtd) with Saints
items.take: Locks in as New Orleans' clear long-term WR1 with zero hold-in risk.

items.headline: Reunites with 49ers on 1-year deal worth up to $7M
items.take: Adds instant target competition to an already banged-up SF WR room (Kirk's calf, Pearsall's knee).

items.headline: Misses practice again in hold-in; Falcons talks trending positive
items.take: No missed-game risk yet, but extension momentum is real - worth tracking for dynasty value.

items.headline: Hold-in continues; Rapoport calls contract talks "concerning"
items.take: Less extension momentum than Robinson's parallel situation - a dynasty value watch, not a workload risk yet.

items.headline: Says he feels "disrespected," contract talks stall well short of ask
items.take: Distraction risk for the Bucs offense entering his walk year; no in-season talks expected.

items.headline: Fully cleared, "full go" for camp after offseason shoulder cleanup
items.take: No restrictions entering camp off his 1,838-yard, 12-TD breakout - workhorse role fully intact.

items.headline: Says lingering foot injury "feels amazing" entering camp
items.take: Confirms full health - Bears WR1 track next to Luther Burden III stays intact.

items.headline: Drawing majority of early-camp targets, working at a "quicker pace"
items.take: Buzz stock in the race to absorb DJ Moore's vacated ~85 targets, though 2nd-year WR leaps are inconsistent.

items.headline: Held out of practice with a calf strain
items.take: With Deebo's signing and Pearsall's knee also in play, SF's WR2/3 picture is genuinely unsettled.

items.headline: Diagnosed with a fractured rib, out indefinitely
items.take: Hurts his bid for the backup RB job behind McCaffrey; rookie Kaelon Black could rise in his absence.

items.headline: Opens camp on PUP (ACL); GM says Week 1 "very much a possibility"
items.take: Monitor closely for dynasty/best-ball TE1 status as camp progresses.

items.headline: Misses practice with knee soreness, recurring PCL issue
items.take: He played through this most of 2025 - worth tracking but not an alarm yet.

items.headline: Confirms his time with the Saints is over, remains unsigned
items.take: No retirement announced, but closes the book on Saints goal-line/gadget TD-vulture risk for now.

items.headline: Makes leaping, twisting catch vs. Trevor Lawrence in 7-on-7
items.take: Deep-league WR3/4 buzz stock in a Jaguars camp already featuring the Tuten backfield story.

items.headline: Returns to practice Thursday for individual drills after back flare-up
items.take: Minor issue as expected - Falcons QB1 job unaffected, on track for Week 1.

items.headline: Full participant in first camp practice, running full routes with no setback
items.take: Biggest green light yet on his ACL/meniscus recovery - Giants' WR1 role fully intact for Week 1 barring a setback.

items.headline: Reports to camp fully, no hold-in despite contract standoff
items.take: Hold-in fears defused for now - workhorse role and volume unaffected entering his extension year.

items.headline: Named 'strongest offensive player, period' at Jaguars camp Day 1
items.take: Further separates from Chris Rodriguez Jr. early, cementing his lead for Jacksonville's early-down/RB1 role.

items.headline: Limited to individual work as he's eased back from offseason foot surgery
items.take: Missed all of OTAs/minicamp recovering - gives Tuten a real head start on early-down/Week 1 committee touches.

items.headline: Dominates red-zone reps with 1st/2nd team in first padded practice
items.take: Rookie flashing home-run ability and pass-game upside - real threat to eat into Allgeier/Conner's early-down share.

items.headline: Catches TD from Mahomes in 7-on-7, earns 1st-team reps as a 5th-round rookie
items.take: Deep-league buzz stock in a crowded Chiefs WR room - worth a late-round dynasty/best-ball flier if reps keep climbing.

items.headline: Confirmed with moderate LCL tear, could miss up to 8 weeks
items.take: Erases his camp helium for now and could cost him the start of the regular season - opens reps in a thin Panthers WR room.

items.headline: Knee swelling from 2025 PCL injury flares up, team 'exploring all options'
items.take: Adds a third question mark (with Kirk's calf and Aiyuk's limbo) to an already muddled 49ers WR2/3 picture behind Mike Evans.

items.headline: Continues beating corners deep in camp, cementing Jets WR2 role
items.take: Camp's clearest ADP riser - solidifying the No. 2 job behind Garrett Wilson after a buzzy OTA/minicamp stretch.

items.headline: Takes first padded practice in two years, no hesitation in cuts per coach
items.take: Real 1B threat to Chuba Hubbard's early-down role building if Brooks can stay on the field this camp.

items.headline: Back tightness flare-up sidelines Falcons QB1 to open camp
items.take: Not considered serious and expected back 'next week' per Schefter, but worth confirming before locking in Atlanta's passing game plans.

items.headline: Still not cleared for full team drills as ACL recovery drags into camp
items.take: Recovery timeline lagging expectations keeps Tua firmly in the Week 1 driver's seat once healthy.

items.headline: Signs with Falcons for emergency camp depth as Tua/Penix both sidelined
items.take: Pure depth add, but worth a passing glance if Atlanta's QB situation stays messy into the week.

items.headline: Stages hold-in at Lions camp amid contract extension talks
items.take: Business decision, not injury - expect him back as Detroit's lead back once a deal lands, reportedly could come 'relatively quickly.'

items.headline: Also sitting out camp practices seeking a market-resetting extension
items.take: Same hold-in dynamic as Gibbs - no fantasy downside expected, just a contract-leverage play to track.

items.headline: Helped off practice field with a leg injury, couldn't bear weight
items.take: Real threat to a camp-buzz rookie's path onto Carolina's Week 1 roster in an already thin WR corps.

items.headline: Rookie WR turning heads early, earning Brock Purdy's trust
items.take: Speculative dynasty/deep-league stash given an unsettled 49ers WR room behind Evans and Pearsall.

items.headline: Says he won't file for reinstatement, wants to sign with Commanders
items.take: Effectively removes him from San Francisco's 2026 fantasy equation; no resolution timeline yet.

items.headline: Rookie 1st-rounder an early frontrunner for Eagles' WR2 job
items.take: Reportedly ahead of incumbent Dontayvion Wicks early in camp - a real target-share battle worth tracking.

items.headline: Facing serious competition from rookie Makai Lemon for the WR2 job
items.take: Prior familiarity with new OC Sean Mannion (both ex-Packers) hasn't been enough to hold off the rookie early on.

items.headline: GM says Week 1 return from ACL tear is 'very much a possibility'
items.take: Modestly more optimistic update on an already-positive outlook for a top-8 fantasy TE.

items.headline: Named Raiders starter over rookie Fernando Mendoza to open camp
items.take: Locks in Week 1 starting value while Mendoza redshirts behind him with the backups.

items.headline: Begins camp as backup behind Kirk Cousins despite No. 1 overall pick status
items.take: No near-term fantasy value, but a clear dynasty stash - watch for any in-season shift.

items.headline: Starts camp on PUP list recovering from torn ACL, expected full-go for Week 1
items.take: No long-term concern for a top-8 fantasy TE, but early camp reps go to Musgrave and others in the meantime.

items.headline: Contract standoff remains unresolved as Ravens veterans report to camp
items.take: Still expected to play under his current deal, but a ballooning 2027 cap hit keeps holdout/distraction risk on the radar.

items.headline: Contract talks with Bucs end without a deal; will play 2026 on his expiring contract
items.take: No on-field change - Mayfield stays Tampa Bay's clear starter, now with a prove-it-year, pending-free-agent subplot.

items.headline: Hamstring injury has sidelined him for multiple camp practices
items.take: Opens up more slot/depth reps behind Khalil Shakir in an already crowded, banged-up Bills WR room.

items.headline: Missing practice time early in Bills camp
items.take: Worth monitoring - he's a TE1-caliber piece if he's healthy for Week 1.

items.headline: Turning heads with another highlight-reel deep catch early in Patriots camp
items.take: Building on 2025 flashes - in play for a bigger WR2 role behind Stefon Diggs.

items.headline: Teammates call rookie 'MVP of our spring' amid crowded Browns WR battle
items.take: Emerging as a real threat to leapfrog Jeudy/Concepcion for target share - deep sleeper riser in a suddenly loaded room.

items.headline: On hamstring 'maintenance' plan, limited through spring - camp reps a key watch
items.take: High-profile rookie complement to Chris Olave; missed spring practice reps raise a small red flag for Week 1 readiness.

items.headline: Worked on pass-pro/blocking this offseason to expand passing-down role
items.take: Better blitz pickup could unlock a full 3-down role after a rookie year capped by pass-pro limitations.

items.headline: Full participant for camp start after shoulder surgery; tests pads Aug. 3
items.take: On track to open as Tampa Bay's lead back with no restrictions reported so far.

items.headline: Fully cleared after herniated disc surgery, expected full-go for camp
items.take: Removes the lingering health question for a top-5 fantasy TE entering a contract year.

items.headline: Hold-in speculation swirls entering camp amid contract standoff
items.take: A hold-in (report but limited practice) wouldn't cost missed games unlike a holdout - workload should stay bell-cow if it happens, but a real contract fight is a QB2-style value risk to monitor.

items.headline: QB battle with J.J. McCarthy expected to run through the preseason, per Rapoport
items.take: Reportedly closing McCarthy's early edge and building chemistry with Jordan Addison - an extended camp battle caps confident startable value for now.

items.headline: No longer a clear favorite over Kyler Murray as camp opens, per report
items.take: Vikings entering camp with no named starter - keeps McCarthy out of confident streaming range into August.

items.headline: Avoiding PUP list; Harbaugh says he'll work into camp reps 'one way or another'
items.take: Realistic shot at a Week 1 return vs. Dallas, but true ACL/meniscus recovery timeline still uncertain - reopens his WR1 ceiling for drafters.

items.headline: Harbaugh: RB will be 'ready early on in camp,' ahead of Nabers in recovery
items.take: Trending toward a normal Week 1 workload as Giants' clear lead back after a gruesome ankle/tibia injury ended his rookie year.

items.headline: Andy Reid says WR is 'doing great,' cleared to practice for camp
items.take: Removes the last real cloud over Chiefs' passing game - locks in as Mahomes' top target entering 2026.

items.headline: Full go from Day 1 of camp, dominating one-on-one reps after 2025 knee injury
items.take: Explosive testing numbers (22.6 mph) and highlight-reel camp reps signal no lingering limitations - trending toward a true 3-down role.

items.headline: Hasn't fully connected with Trevor Lawrence through first week of camp practices
items.take: Minor early-camp rhythm issue, not alarming yet - worth a follow-up once pads come on and target competition with Hunter ramps up.

items.headline: Starts camp on active/PUP list recovering from ankle surgery
items.take: Colts in no rush to activate him - monitor for Week 1 clarity as a WR3 in a run-heavy offense.

items.headline: Strains calf in first 49ers practice, out indefinitely
items.take: Opens early camp reps behind Mike Evans/Ricky Pearsall - Kirk's WR3 role now murky entering a new offense.

items.headline: Reports suggest Deshaun Watson maintaining edge in Browns QB battle
items.take: Sanders' path to Week 1 starts narrows despite splitting first-team camp reps.

items.headline: Rookie 1st-rounder pushing Jerry Jeudy for top WR job in camp
items.take: Going later than Jeudy in early drafts - camp target-share battle worth tracking closely.

items.headline: Signs new 1-year, $15.5M deal with Cardinals
items.take: Cements him as camp's presumptive starter over Gardner Minshew and rookie Carson Beck.

items.headline: Rookie 3rd-rounder impresses in first camp practice
items.take: No near-term fantasy relevance behind Brissett, but a dynasty stash name after a sharp camp debut.

items.headline: Cleared for full practice as Chiefs open training camp
items.take: No restrictions reported recovering from torn ACL/LCL - on track for Week 1.

items.headline: Says he feels 'really good,' full-go for Colts camp opener
items.take: No lingering effects from 2025 Achilles tear - locks in as Week 1 starter.

items.headline: Coach Liam Coen says he's expecting a 'big year' from Tuten
items.take: With Etienne now in New Orleans, Tuten profiles as Jacksonville's clear early-down/goal-line back.

items.headline: Fully healthy, in line for Week 1 RB1 role with Charbonnet on PUP
items.take: ADP (84) hasn't caught up to his opportunity - real value spike as camp's clear early-down starter.

items.headline: Takes first-team reps, coach says he looks like 'the guy I remember'
items.take: First healthy camp since back-to-back ACL tears - trending toward a 1-2 punch with Chuba Hubbard.

items.headline: Placed on active/PUP list recovering from torn ACL
items.take: Confirms an early-season absence and clears the runway for rookie Jadarian Price to start.

items.headline: Restructures contract (pay cut) to stay with Saints for 2026
items.take: Now expected to split backfield work with new signee Travis Etienne - workload likely capped below past bell-cow levels.
